plugins.name: Meshcore
plugins.description: Show Meshcore network nodes on the MeshPulse map alongside Meshtastic. Connects to a Meshcore companion node over USB serial or TCP and injects its known nodes as diamond markers, with Meshtastic/Meshcore layer toggles. Read-only in v1 — no messages, telemetry or node configuration.
plugins.dependencies_note: Requires meshcore library (auto-installed) + a Meshcore companion node
plugins.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial release — read-only node ingestion from Meshcore companion (serial/TCP), periodic contact sync, live advert subscription

plugins.name: Elevation Map
plugins.description: Terrain overlay for the map — switch base tiles (OpenTopoMap, Esri Topo, Shaded Relief) plus a stackable Hillshade overlay that shows terrain shading over any base map. Frontend-only.
plugins.changelog: v1.0.3: panel registered through the core api.panels API — appears in the mobile "Map Layers" drawer, with a fallback guard for cores older than 2.6.1. v1.0.2: dropped dead Stamen provider (now Esri Topo), added Hillshade overlay, migrated to monorepo

plugins.name: MQTT Proxy
plugins.description: MQTT client proxy for trackers without WiFi. Publishes mesh packets to MQTT broker and receives downlink on behalf of the connected tracker. Reads MQTT config directly from tracker firmware — zero manual configuration.
plugins.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial release — uplink, downlink, implicit ACK, retained message filtering

plugins.name: Meshtastic BBS
plugins.description: Bulletin Board System for Meshtastic mesh networks — inspired by FidoNet BBS systems of the 1980s/90s. Public bulletin boards, private mail with store & forward, node directory, and a classic terminal UI — over the radio and, on core 2.7.0+, in a browser tab.
plugins.changelog: v1.1.0: web board viewer — the BBS tab in the MeshPulse navbar opens a browsable view of the boards, netmail, node directory and stats (needs core 2.7.0 for manifest page tabs; the mesh side still runs on 2.2.0+). Transport moved to the plugin WebSocket channel; fixes a missing register_ws_channel() and swapped broadcast_ws() arguments that kept live events from ever arriving. v1.0.6: _c_about returns default when about_message is empty, support \n in config

plugins.name: Weather Overlay
plugins.description: Shows environment sensor data (temperature, humidity, barometric pressure) as map labels and heatmap overlay for nodes reporting environmentMetrics. Labels visible at zoom ≥ 10, heatmap always on. Metric choice persists across refreshes.
plugins.changelog: v1.0.3: renders from the map’s visible node set (api.nodes.getVisible, core 2.7.0) and re-renders on filter changes — labels and heatmap no longer survive filtering their nodes off the map; falls back to getAll() on older cores. v1.0.2: panel registered through the core api.panels API — appears in the mobile "Map Layers" drawer, with a fallback guard for cores older than 2.6.1
